value.rationale: The initiating oncology model deliberately makes an infinitesimal-cycle simplification to optimize dosing. The theorem identifies exactly when that approximation overestimates versus underestimates growth for every physically finite dosing period, and the admissible saturating dose-response example changes the sign of asymptotic population growth. This is a model-specific stability boundary, not an arbitrary numeric example or marginal gain.
